hooks.command: f="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/.claude/worklogs/_open-items.md"; [ -f "$f" ] && jq -Rs "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"SessionStart\",additionalContext:(\"TECHNICAL DIRECTOR OPEN ITEMS — lead your first message with these, then run: bash .claude/worklogs/read-all.sh\n\n\" + .)}}" < "$f" || true

c=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command"); if printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qE "git[[:space:]]+push([[:space:]]+[^[:space:]]+)*[[:space:]]+(HEAD:)?main([[:space:]]|$)|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+.*:main([[:space:]]|$)"; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\"Pushing to main is forbidden by the Rules of Engagement in CLAUDE.md. Every change goes through a pull request. Push your branch and open one.\"}}"; fi

c=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command"); if printf "%s" "$c" | grep -qE "supabase[[:space:]]+migration[[:space:]]+repair"; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\"migration repair rewrites the database's own record of what was applied. The gap it would close is deliberate — migration 20260908235234 is withheld because it contains personal data. See supabase/README.md.\"}}"; fi

d=$(jq -r ".tool_input | if has(\"draft\") then (.draft|tostring) else \"absent\" end"); if [ "$d" != "true" ]; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\"Every pull request here opens as a draft — see CLAUDE.md. Pass draft: true. You say it is ready, Joel approves in chat, and Joel promotes it; no agent promotes one.\"}}"; fi

d=$(jq -r ".tool_input | if has(\"draft\") then (.draft|tostring) else \"absent\" end"); if [ "$d" = "false" ]; then jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\"Promoting a pull request is Joel's, not yours. He marks it ready for review himself, which is the sanity check the draft rule exists for — see CLAUDE.md. Record his approval on the pull request and ask him to promote it. Converting one back to draft is still allowed.\"}}"; fi
